messages:
devin: kicking off west4 region bring-up. Goal: GPU pool + GitOps deploy pipeline + cross-region image sync. Need checklist and owners.

ashley: +1. Primary concerns: image registry replication lag, quota for A100s in west4, and cluster-level network egress routes.

matt: FYI I opened infra PR #4217 for the GitOps overlay (helm values + kustomize patch). Link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4217

priya: for ML tests, we need a validation job that runs perf sweep on a small fleet: 2xA100 mimic, 128 batch, seq_len 512. If quotas are tight we can use 1xA100 + INT8 profile.

ashley: action items I'm assigning: registry replication (ashley), quota & billing estimate (matt), cluster bootstrap manifest + RBAC (devin), perf validation harness (priya), security review (cody).

devin: registry replication note: current sync script using skopeo is flaky with interruptions. Suggest switching to `gcrane` for resumable copies. Example command:

```
# copy image set from eu-registry to us-west4-reg
gcrane cp --insecure --retry=5 eu.gcr.io/redwood/models:v1 us.gcr.io/redwood-west4/models:v1
```

ashley: +1 on gcrane. Also we'll need signed manifests on destination. I'll add a post-copy manifest-signer step to the job.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline job queued: infra-ci/west4/gcr-sync (job id: 78312) :gear:

sasha: namespace and nodepool naming conventions? Can we stick to `west4-gpu-<tier>` and `rg-west4-01` for resource group? Keeps things consistent with the autoscaler scripts.

devin: yes, use `west4-gpu-prod` and `west4-gpu-burst` nodepools. Autoscaler min:0 max:8 for prod, burst max:32. We'll request initial reserved capacity of 4 A100s.

matt: cost heads-up: A100 reserved in that region costs ~1.8x compared to eu-west2. I'll put an estimated monthly cost in the PR comment, and a t-shirt estimate in the ticket.

priya: validation plan rough steps: 1) smoke deploy a tiny model, 2) run latency sweep (p50/p95), 3) run token throughput test (concurrency 4), 4) check kv-cache cold/hot behavior. I can provide the harness job.

ashley: network note: need to open egress to artifact registry and to internal metrics collectors. We'll also add a VPC peering rule to telemetry-prod.

cody: security checklist: private registries must use VPC-SC, image signing required, cluster RBAC audit enabled, and KMS keys must be customer-managed for private installs. I'll do a quick audit.

devin: GitOps deploy details: helm charts under `infra-charts/cluster-bootstrap`. We will add a new overlay `overlays/west4` with values: `gpu.nodePools`, `registry.mirror`, and `ingress.annotations` for the region LB. Helm command for canary apply:

```
helm upgrade --install cluster-bootstrap . -f overlays/west4/values.yaml --namespace infra --atomic --wait --timeout 10m
```

matt: note: CI must validate that the kustomize/helm output contains `nodePool: west4-gpu-prod` and that `autoScaler` settings are present. I'll add a lint step to infra-ci.

deploy-bot: infra-ci/west4/deploy-helm started (job id: 78345)

ashley: replication got 60% through then timed out earlier. I've added a backoff retry and chunked copy. Will re-run and report in ~30m.

priya: if replication delays persist, we can configure the runtime to fallback to eu images with routing policy `prefer-local` so requests hit eu until sync completes. That keeps services up.

devin: good call. We'll set rollout policy to `canary: region=west4, weight=10` and fallback set to `region=eu-west2`.

cody: remember to add an audit webhook to log cross-region image pulls for compliance.

matt: quota request submitted to cloud vendor (ticket 99211). ETA ~48 hours. If quota denied, plan B is to start with smaller GPU types and do quantized perf tests.

ashley: replicate job finished successfully. checksum verified. PR #4219 contains the replication pipeline changes.

devin: running cluster bootstrap now. Watching pod states: kube-system mostly ready, coredns CrashLoopBackOff for a minute then recovered.

priya: started perf job: runs are green. p50 latency 82ms, p95 240ms on the 1xA100 validation node. Throughput looks linear up to 64 tokens/sec.

matt: ran cost projection in spreadsheet and added it to PR. Also created jira INF-307 for monitoring retention costs.

cody: completed security audit: RBAC gaps fixed, images signed, KMS key rotation scheduled. Leaving notes in the infra repo.

devin: ok, owners: ashley (registry + replication), matt (quota + CI), priya (validation), cody (security), sasha (oncall handoff). Next step: docs and handoff meeting.

ashley: I've pushed a small runbook `docs/west4-oncall.md` with quick checks (nodepool size, registry sync status, `kubectl get pods -n infra`).

sasha: I'll take oncall for the first two weeks. Schedule handoff meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT and share calendar invite.

deploy-bot: ticket INF-306 transitioned to "staged" by devin

devin: thanks everyone. If no major issues in the smoke window (2h), we'll flip the traffic canary to 50% and then full.

ashley: all green here. flipping to canary 50% in 30m. :rocket:

priya: monitoring alerts pre-configured: GPU-util spike, registry lag >15m, model-deadlocks. I set thresholds and dashboards.

matt: final note - leave a note in billing channel when we commit reserved capacity. I'll coordinate with finance.

devin: handoff: sasha will be primary oncall, matt backup, ashley handles replication incidents. Closing thread after handoff meeting.
